plans.name: study-modal-shell-and-catalog
plans.prompt: Implement TradingView Indicators, metrics, and strategies modal shell with full category navigation (Personal, Built-in, Community), sub-tab pills (Indicators, Strategies, Profiles, Patterns, Options, Fundamentals), real-time search, favorite starring, and study catalog backend service.

plans.name: dynamic-subpanes-and-indicators
plans.prompt: Implement dynamic stacked sub-panes engine for Lightweight Charts, supporting multi-pane oscillators (RSI, MACD, Stochastic, ATR), main pane overlays (SMA, EMA, VWAP, Bollinger Bands, Supertrend), indicator HUD legends (hide/show, settings gear, remove), and synchronized time-scale crosshairs.

plans.name: volume-profiles-and-market-profiles
plans.prompt: Implement Volume Profile suite (Visible Range VRVP canvas histogram with dynamic 60fps recalculation on pan/zoom, Session Volume Profile SVP with daily POC/VAH/VAL levels) and Time Price Opportunity (TPO / Market Profile 30-min letter brackets).

plans.name: patterns-strategies-and-options
plans.prompt: Implement Candlestick & Chart Patterns recognition with chart badge markers and educational tooltips, Strategy Tester integration with Buy/Sell execution arrows and docked Strategy Summary, Options study overlays (Max Pain, PCR, Strike OI), and Personal/Community preset saving.
